title: fix(plugin-form): WizardForm's footer and step chrome resolve through the i18n catalogue (objectui#10999)
body:
Fixes #10999
Clause-②: no

## What

`WizardForm`'s own chrome now resolves through the i18n catalogue instead of English literals. It goes through the wizard's existing `createSafeTranslation` hook (`useWizardTranslation`), the same factory plugin-form's other chrome uses (the `ModalForm` / `DrawerForm` discard dialog, `uploadGate`, `LineItemsPanel`, `occSave`). The hook's defaults table stays byte-identical to the `en` pack (`pnpm check:i18n-keys` compares the two), so a provider-less host still renders English.

| String | Key | zh |
|---|---|---|
| Cancel | `common.cancel` (existing) | 取消 |
| Back | `wizard.back` (new) | 上一步 |
| Next | `common.next` (existing) | 下一步 |
| Submitting… | `wizard.submitting` (new) | 提交中… |
| Create / Update | `form.create` / `form.update` (existing) | 创建 / 更新 |
| Step x of y | `form.stepOf` (existing; one interpolated key, `{{current}}` / `{{total}}`) | 第 1 步，共 3 步 |
| `Step N` indicator fallback | `wizard.stepFallback` (new, `{{n}}`) | 第 1 步 |
| step indicator `aria-label` "Progress" | `wizard.progressLabel` (new) | 进度 |
| "No fields configured for this step" | `wizard.emptyStep` (new) | 此步骤未配置字段 |

- An authored `cancelText` / `prevText` / `nextText` / `submitText` still wins verbatim (the same `||` as before). The four keys stay plain `string`: no schema key added, renamed or retyped.
- `wizard.back` rather than `common.back`: zh `common.back` is 返回 (a page back), while a wizard's step back is 上一步, the term `grid.import.back` and `grid.bulk.back` already use. In the other eight packs `wizard.back` equals `common.back`. Each pack's `wizard.submitting` is its `flowRunner.submitting` value (the same action in the flow runner); there is no generic `submitting` key.
- `form.stepOf` was already in all ten packs with nothing reading it: `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys` listed it as confirmed dead at the merge base, and it is off that list now. Its zh value gains the spaces the zh pack's other position counters carry (`table.pageInfo`, `detail.recordOf`): 第{{current}}步 becomes 第 {{current}} 步.

### Two literals beyond the card's list (same file, same defect class)

The card named the footer, the counter and the `Step N` fallback. Reading `WizardForm.tsx` on `origin/main` found two more strings of the same chrome: the step indicator's `aria-label="Progress"` and the empty-step notice "No fields configured for this step". Both are fixed here under the bounded in-place rule (same defect class, same file and claim, mechanical, same i18n gate family). The zh pin asserts both: the navigation landmark named 进度, and 此步骤未配置字段 on the field-less step.

### One English rendering change

The in-flight label was typed `Submitting...` with three ASCII full stops. As a pack value it is `Submitting…` with U+2026, because `ellipsis-glyph-3878.test.ts` holds every pack value to that glyph. Every other English default renders the same text as before. The changeset says so.

## Pin

`WizardForm.i18nChrome-10999.test.tsx` in `packages/plugin-form/src`, four cases under a real `I18nProvider`:

- zh: 取消, 下一步, 第 1 步，共 2 步, the navigation landmark 进度 and the indicator label 第 1 步 on step 1; 上一步, 创建, 第 2 步，共 2 步 and 此步骤未配置字段 on the last step; 提交中… while `create` is in flight; and no English default anywhere in the rendered text.
- zh, edit mode: 更新.
- zh with all four author keys set: each renders as authored, and that button's localized default is absent. The case first waits for a probe outside the wizard to read the zh catalogue, so it runs under a live zh pack.
- en: Cancel, Next, Step 1 of 2, Progress, Step 1, Back, Create, Submitting….

Red leg at `b20db4c5d`: `WizardForm.tsx` replaced by the merge-base blob (`5ebead81`, hash-checked on disk; the count of `t('common.cancel')` went from 1 to 0), everything else at HEAD: **3 failed, 1 passed**. Both zh-default cases fail with `Unable to find role="button" and name "下一步"`; the en case fails only at `name "Submitting…"` (the glyph change above); the authored case passes, because author values always won, so it is the must-not-change guard. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --` and verified by blob hash (`0aabde44` equals the HEAD blob) and an empty `git diff HEAD`. Green at the same head: 4 passed.

## Verification (all at `b20db4c5d`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/i18n/ packages/plugin-form/`: Test Files 211 passed (211), Tests 2806 passed, 14 skipped (2820). This includes `all-locales-key-parity`, `en-zh-key-parity`, `ellipsis-glyph-3878`, `untranslated-identity-4376` and `raw-key-call-sites-3546`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check`: both Done, after building the dependency closure with `pnpm --filter "@object-ui/plugin-form^..." build`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` in `packages/plugin-form` lists the pin.
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys` exit 0 (35 factory tables, 884 rows, 884 matching). `pnpm check:i18n-drift` exit 0 (0 en values changed, 5 keys added). `pnpm check:control-bytes` OK. `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: 0 new. `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` passes. `pnpm changeset:check` passes. `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals` passes. `pnpm check:changeset-claims` (report-only) names two pending changesets that mention touched files, `6237-wizard-step-config-split` and `6661-app-launcher-nav-menu-renderers`: both re-read, both still true.
- `scripts/__tests__`, derived with `git grep -l -E "WizardForm|i18n/src/locales|locales/en|plugin-form/src|plugin-form'|\.changeset" -- 'scripts/__tests__/*.test.ts'`: 36 files, Test Files 36 passed, Tests 1823 passed.
- eslint on the 12 touched source files (`--format json` reports 12 files): 0 errors and 21 warnings, all on `WizardForm.tsx` and equal to the merge-base file's 21. Why the narrowing excludes nothing: `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService` (no type-aware linting), and no rule under `eslint-rules/` reads another file, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- Eager closure (Bundle Analysis): no import edge is added, because `WizardForm.tsx` already imported `createSafeTranslation` from `@object-ui/i18n`. The only eager bytes are the five new `en` rows: the minified `en` pack grows by 140 B, 35 B gzipped (esbuild, merge base against head). On a local console build, `pnpm check:eager-closure` passes: 3105.4 KB gzipped across 330 of 2446 chunks, headroom 44.0 KB, and `i18n-locale-en` at 40.9 KB against its 48.8 KB ceiling. `pnpm check:eager-locale-catalogues` exits 0.

## Acceptance notes (observed, not fixed here)

The same family (hard-coded English in plugin-form), outside this card's claim:

- Success feedback: the default toast `Created` / `Saved` (ObjectForm, WizardForm, MasterDetailForm) and the thank-you title `Thanks!` (ObjectForm, WizardForm, the console's `FormPage`).
- Load states: `Loading form...` / `Error loading form` in ObjectForm, TabbedForm, SplitForm, WizardForm, DrawerForm and ModalForm.
- `NAVIGATE_ON_SUCCESS_REFUSED_NOTE`, shared by ObjectForm and WizardForm.

No zh render of these was measured in this run.

Docs: the Multi-Step Form section of `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx` and `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md` do not state the chrome defaults, so no page becomes false; none is edited.
